title: Implementing Light/Dark Mode Switcher
content: To implement the light/dark mode switcher, I used a toggle input with a checkbox type and styled it to look like a switch using CSS. I used JavaScript to create a change between light and dark mode with a change event. The change event adds a dark mode class to the body when activated.
